decisions: B1: real per-variant proptest shrinking via build_strategy_for + drive_strategy
B2: cursor = bundle_id, forward pagination, next_cursor=Some(last.bundle_id) when page is full
B3: dedicated events_count MCP tool (avoids bundle-deserialize round-trip)
B4: M8 close report following m7 close precedent

modify: shrink() now calls drive_strategy(...) instead of returning ShrinkOutcome::ShrunkSameInputs
rounds_used semantics: initial-validation + 1 simplify attempt = 2 (for Just(base) strategies)

rationale.why_SBoxedStrategy: BoxedStrategy is !Send (boxes dyn Strategy without Send bound), breaking #[tool]'s Send requirement. SBoxedStrategy requires T: Send + Sync + 'static, which HypothesisInput's String/u64/Option<Enum> satisfy (R5).
rationale.why_rebuild_each_iter: dyn ValueTree is !Send; cannot hold across .await. drive_strategy rebuilds strategy+tree each iteration, asks the fresh tree to simplify() once. For Just(base), simplify() returns false immediately (R7).

list_pagination_cursor.store_filter: list_counterexample_bundles iterates store, skips rows where bundle_id <= cursor (uuid::v7 = chronological order)
list_pagination_cursor.service_semantics: next_cursor = Some(last.bundle_id) when summaries.len() == limit, None otherwise. Caller fetches an empty page to discover end.
tests_modified: ce4_list_after_shrink_includes_bundle: now uses limit=u32::MAX for stable cursor=None
sandbox ce8 NEW: ce8_list_pagination_forward_cursor (asserts page2 cursors > page1 cursors; robust to shared redb path because fixtures are populated in-test)

events_count_tool.service_method: pub async fn ChronosCounterexampleService::events_count(ctx, bundle_id) -> Result<CounterexampleOutput, ServiceError>
events_count_tool.disclosure: events_count returns the value persisted at save time, NOT a live re-read (matches m8-04 save()-time events_count semantics).
events_count_tool.sandbox_ce9: ce9_events_count_returns_persisted_length: shrink a constant target on test_busyloop, then call events_count, assert events_count >= 1

tests_run.t2_lib_unit_changed_crates: 243 chronos-services + 25 chronos-store + 11 chronos-mcp + 18 chronos-cli = 297 tests, all green

disclosures.R1: Real per-variant shrinking requires a populated engines map (test fixtures populate one). Empty map → SessionNotFound + target unchanged.
disclosures.R2: Empty engines map → SessionNotFound, no new ServiceError variant. Documented in service module docs.
disclosures.R3: Per-variant strategy returns Just(base); no real shrinking yet. Future cycle swaps the three helper bodies without changing signatures.
disclosures.R4: HypothesisInput must satisfy Send + Sync + 'static for SBoxedStrategy. Current shape (String, u64, Option<Enum>) qualifies; future variants must audit this requirement.
disclosures.R5: SBoxedStrategy required for the MCP #[tool] Send bound. Accepted constraint, not a bug.
disclosures.R6: Shrink requires populated engines map (same as R1/R2).
disclosures.R7: dyn ValueTree: !Send; drive_strategy rebuilds strategy+tree each iteration. A future real-shrinker cycle must address this (e.g., ValueTree: Send feature flag, or move loop into spawn_blocking).

notes: m8-05 was scoped doc-first (03b9100 -> FF-merged to main as a87d6a4 before any code).
Four execute commits (real shrinking, pagination, events_count, close report) each landed and tested before the next.

Smoke subset for T4 was counterexample_tools + e2e_connectivity -- picked per AGENTS.md §2 (counterexample_tools covers the changed wire envelope + list + events_count; e2e_connectivity is the server-startup canary).

rounds_used == 2 is honest: for Just(base) strategies, simplify() returns false immediately, so the loop does the initial validation + 1 simplify attempt and exits. A real-shrinker future cycle will see higher counts.
Pagination next_cursor = Some when page is full (not when more rows exist). This is the standard 'cursor when more pages MAY exist' semantics; callers fetch an empty page to discover end.
events_count is persisted-at-save, not live-re-read. A m9+ shortcut could surface a live re-read if needed.
M8 is closed. m9+ backlog has 8 items including real shrinkers, byte-faithful replay, bundle-as-blob -> side table, single-call session_stop, attach domain API, distributed tracing, MCP hardening.

R7 (ValueTree Send) - rebuild-each-iter pattern is the work-around; future real-shrinker cycle must address
